facts.text: Grimny's ghost believes he was killed by his brother Bral, the greediest of the seven dwarves (the dwarf the party won its map from). Did Bral kill Grimny, and how?
Grimny says the seven dwarves amassed a hoard from the mine, selling metal to the town but keeping the good stuff. Where is the dwarves' hoard now?
Is the magical ring Dunk took from Grimny's body and put on, which let him see and speak with Grimny's ghost, cursed?
